name: Brass Portafilter
svgFragment:
<g id="PROP-PORTAFILTER">
  <!-- Drop Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="240" rx="110" ry="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2"/>
  
  <!-- Spouts (Bottom) -->
  <path d="M115 180 L110 205 L130 205 L135 180 Z" fill="#d97706" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M165 180 L170 205 L150 205 L145 180 Z" fill="#d97706" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  
  <!-- Main Brass Head -->
  <circle cx="140" cy="150" r="55" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="7"/>
  
  <!-- Filter Basket (Top) -->
  <circle cx="140" cy="150" r="40" fill="#94a3b8" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="140" cy="150" r="32" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Heavy Handle -->
  <rect x="185" y="130" width="140" height="40" rx="20" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="7"/>
  
  <!-- Handle Grip Details -->
  <line x1="220" y1="135" x2="220" y2="165" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="240" y1="135" x2="240" y2="165" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="135" x2="260" y2="165" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Metallic Sheen / Highlights -->
  <path d="M110 130 A45 45 0 0 1 170 115" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="200" y="138" width="100" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
  
  <!-- Connection Bolt -->
  <circle cx="185" cy="150" r="8" fill="#d97706" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="4"/>
</g>
